title: Project Sidekick briefing on the craft as a particle beam weapon

tellings.quote: Sidekick was the weapon potential of the craft.

plain: A man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked on a craft at a secret site in Nevada called S-4 around 1988 and 1989, says he read a briefing for something called Project Sidekick, which dealt with the craft's potential as a weapon, a particle beam weapon. In his words, "Sidekick was the weapon potential of the craft." He tells it on the show as someone who says he saw the briefing himself, and if true it would mean officials were studying the craft as a possible weapon.
